caveats: Visual action known only from a stage direction. Dwight being hit by Mose's manure (S4E4) is implied by audio ('Ow!'), not shown in the transcript; an answer naming Dwight for that scene is partially defensible but the clear case is Andy. Watch for reversal: Angela slaps Mose in S8E24; Mose wrestling Ryan (S3E5) never happens, Ryan refuses.
reference: Mose hits Andy: in The Surplus (S5E9), at Schrute Farms, right after Dwight's fake/real wedding trick with Angela, Mose hits Andy in the head with a deflated ball (Andy: 'Ow!'). That is the only on-screen case of Mose hitting a person in the transcripts. Related but not the main answer: in Dwight K. Schrute's Farm (S4E4) Mose apparently throws manure at Dwight off-screen (Dwight: 'Do not throw it! ... Ow!').
